summary: IRSA Investments & Representations Inc. filed a Form 6-K attaching an English translation of a payment notice for its Fixed Rate Series XX Notes due 2026. The notice details the fourth installment of interest and capital amortization, with a principal amount of USD 23,015,242, an annual nominal interest rate of 6.00%, and interest payment of USD 688,565.60. Payment is scheduled for June 10, 2026, through Caja de Valores S.A. as paying agent. This is a routine debt servicing notification, not a special situation event.
